description: This script automates configuring, building, installing, and running unit tests for the RBUS project. It sets up build directories, invokes CMake with specific options, and runs unit tests if available. It is intended to be executed from the repository root to manage the build process.

methods.name: mkdir -p
methods.description: Creates necessary directories for build and install.

methods.name: cmake
methods.description: Configures the build system with specified options, such as enabling unit testing and desktop build configuration.

methods.name: cmake --build
methods.description: Builds and installs the project targets in parallel.
